facts.text: The image is a dragon reference sheet: a wide hero view spans the top, with two rows of smaller panels beneath.
In the hero view, a large black, heavily scaled dragon is crouched on four legs with its wings spread, its horned head lowered, and its long tail extending behind it.
The dragon has multiple long, pale horns projecting from its head, a long snout, and a glowing orange eye visible in the head close-up.
The wings are large, dark, and membranous, with visible finger-like struts; a lower panel isolates the wing membrane.
The dragon has four clawed feet; a close-up panel shows a foot with curved claws.
A scale-detail panel shows overlapping dark scales with subtle blue-gray highlights.
The middle row contains FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR full-body views; the bottom row contains HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL panels.
The hero view is set in dark volcanic terrain with rocky mountains, a misty or smoky atmosphere, reflective wet ground, and scattered glowing orange patches.
